added_failure_derivation: The reviewed run's manifest carries no baseline_suite and no after_suite arms: it is a read-only docs census whose gate is the -run.py exit status, recorded in census-gate.log's final line as EXIT=0. With no suite arms there are no failure ids to diff, so the added failure count is 0 by absence of arms rather than by measurement.
call_sites_note: The change adds a docs/evidence fragment, its JSON and a standalone run script under docs/; no module under imas_codex/ or tests/ references them, so there is no production call site to check. The nearest owned code read for the reuse judgement was imas_codex/standard_names/review/consolidation.py (position suffixes), imas_codex/standard_names/coverage.py (separatrix pair gaps) and imas_codex/standard_names/harmonize.py (family drift), none of which owns a locus-to-suffix mapping.

findings.text: agrees is computed from sourced_live and named_live, both selected out of rows by the same predicates that built rows, so it is true for any non-empty census and can never fail; the HTML at run.py:721-741 then publishes census_live_count as the 'union of the two independent readings 98' while the two independent counts it records (87 and 94) can have a union of at most 94, so the declared negative control verifies nothing.

a rename whose target is a superseded tombstone is emitted as signed_rename with proposed_target set to that tombstone name (flux_surface_averaged_parallel_electric_field_at_separatrix, toroidal_deuterium_tritium_velocity_at_plasma_boundary, toroidal_helium_4_velocity_at_plasma_boundary, toroidal_krypton_velocity_at_plasma_boundary), contradicting the done_when's 'never targets a superseded tombstone' and leaving only a free-text collision note to tell a fresh composition from a revival.

the bare toroidal_tritium_velocity stub is emitted as supersede_onto_holder targeting toroidal_tritium_velocity_at_separatrix, but the node's own tritium block records existing null for that name, so the action claims a holder the graph does not have and the guard at run.py:394 only refuses a superseded holder, never an absent one.

the tombstone loop reads required, which is assigned only inside the live loop at run.py:314, so each tombstone's locus depends on the last live name examined and the loop raises NameError whenever there are no live names; the present run is masked because that last value happened to select no mixed locus.

the head commit regenerated this file and the HTML (generated_at 08:39:40) after editing render(), but census-gate.log's header names revision df1f9d2e5, so the delivered revision has no logged run of its own; the head diff touches only generated_at, which is what carries the count agreement.
